title: Securities Entity Register Ontology
description: An open OWL 2 + SKOS + SHACL model for register integrity in US securities entity identification, measured against the EDGAR entity register, the GLEIF LEI golden copy, the open ISIN-LEI mapping, and the SEC N-PORT/N-CEN structured datasets. Companion artifact to the Register Assurance programme.
